product_metadata.title: Linteum Textile 12 Piece Face Towel Set, 12x12 Inch, 100% Soft Cotton 16 Single Ring Spun Washcloths Absorbent Durable Face Towel (Beige)
features: QUALITY AND QUANTITY: The set includes 12 quality face towels. Each towel measures 12"x12", making it perfect for use in bathrooms, kitchen, gym, spas, fingertips, makeup removal, hotels and for other cleaning and washing purposes.

MADE FROM QUALITY MATERIAL: The Linteum washcloths and face towels are made from 100% soft and 16s ring spun pure cotton making them perfectly soft and durable. Perfect to dry face & hands, wash your body or remove makeup. Cotton material is easy to wash and dry and remains soft and comfortable even after repeated washing.

MULTIPURPOSE TOWELS: This washcloth towel set of 12 allows you to use these elegant towels as per all your needs. Whether its for all your bathrooms, for the gym or even just carrying them along for a picnic. The towels are pure cotton fabric, and the classic colors are perfect for all functions and purposes.
THE PERFECT PACKAGE: The Linteum Face Towel Set are a combination of softness and durability. Their high absorbency and ease of care, gives the user the required cleaning and drying efficiency.

EASY CARE: The washcloths are easy to wash and dry. Machine washable and dryer friendly, the washcloths are designed to avoid shrinking after every wash and sustain its original structure. Avoid bleaching and other extreme cleaning agents to retain texture and softness. To prevent linting, we recommend air drying the washcloths in the dryer before washing.
